Service Environment

PROFESSIONAL AUTOMOTIVE WORKSHOP

Our workshop is set up for organised, methodical vehicle care. Each vehicle is inspected, diagnosed and discussed with its owner before maintenance or repair begins.

With 30+ years of automotive experience, our team combines practical mechanical skill with an engineering-focused approach to every job.

WHAT WE HANDLE

Diagnostics

Systematic checks to locate the real cause of engine, electrical and performance problems before any work starts.

Mechanical Engineering

Engineering-led solutions for mechanical problems that go beyond routine part replacement.

Maintenance

Periodic servicing and preventive maintenance to keep your vehicle reliable and road-ready.

Repair

Careful repair work on engines, brakes, suspension, AC and electrical systems.
